name: Sakura no Uta Re:Graphic Append Disc
original_name: サクラノ詩 Re:Graphic アペンドディスク
source: A fandisc included in the Sakura no Uta 10th Anniversary edition featuring after stories for Rin, Rina & Yuumi connected to the sequel Sakura no Toki and other unreleased works in the Sakura no series.
translation: 《樱花之歌》10周年纪念版中包含的同人光盘，收录了与续集《樱花之时》以及《樱花之歌》系列中其他未发行作品相关的凛、莉娜和悠美的后续故事。
